corpus.identity_policy: v19 v2 atlas rows require independent teacher_crest and teacher_crest_valid sidecars pinned by each medial_state SHA

evaluation.blind_review_note: Blind gates must include a shrink-side coverage floor versus the incumbent before any promotion; the v16 interval01 report passed one-sided anti-blob gates while removing 6x more voxels than it added.
evaluation.checkpoint_policy: retain every declared sample milestone; select on held-out calibrated macro Dice plus blinded PHerc1447 visual review with two-sided morphology gates
evaluation.threshold_band_change_note: v16 clamped calibration to [0.40, 0.60] and every measured model calibrated at exactly 0.40, the clamp boundary; the widened band makes the sub-0.40 probability reserve measurable. A calibrated optimum sitting at 0.25 must be treated as a censoring alarm, not an operating point.

objective.confident_agreement_note: Teacher-confident means q <= teacher_background_max_q or q >= 0.5. Hard-vote background agreement inside the partial-volume band anchored exactly the voxels the fine teacher wants grown; shrink-side dynamics (separation shell, blob-disagreement CE) are unchanged.
objective.medial_note: Crest recall is per-sample normalized with Villa smooth=1; the crest-keyed shell falls back to occupancy positives where crest validity is absent.

parameter_trust_region.provenance_note: Radius and learning rate carried unchanged from the approved v16 optimizer selection. That selection was measured under the v2 objective whose unconstrained direction was net-shrink; projection-active fraction must be logged and reviewed, and radius re-screening under the v3 objective is expected follow-up, not part of this single-variable run.

candidate.hypothesis: Two complete deterministic corpus passes test whether additional exposure and repetition recover faint longitudinal strips and hard de-blobbed structure before changing the medial formulation or its weight.
candidate.label: dynconn_w0p03125_n8192_duration

scientific_change.description: Restart the winning raw weight-0.03125 candidate from released M7 and vary only cumulative training duration through 8192 samples.

single_axis.rule: Start from released M7 once and change only cumulative training duration. Dynamic-medial weight 0.03125, corpus, deterministic sample order, objective, optimizer, constant learning rate, batch, accumulation, trust radius, validation cadence, threshold evaluation, and raw no-blend inference remain fixed.
